criteria.requirement: Prepare the policy-selected version and release notes for completed product changes.
criteria.pass_when: VERSION becomes 1.3.0; matching 2026-09-07 notes contain the completed JSON addition and CSV compatibility; new Unreleased and prior 1.2.0 history remain. One coherent local metadata commit; no unimplemented product changes described as released.
criteria.fail_when: Wrong bump, divergent version source, undated/mismatched notes, removed history, or unimplemented product changes represented as released. Hosted publication, external CI and retry assertions are judged by their dedicated criteria; they also fail this criterion when they contradict version or released-product facts.
criteria.evidence: Inspect authoritative VERSION, CHANGELOG.md, final metadata diff/commit and report claims about version and product changes. Ordinary captured Git and command records support these facts. Hidden oracle results are separate and are not supplied to the semantic scorer.

criteria.requirement: Review and check the final release candidate.
criteria.pass_when: Captured trace and Git snapshots show final intended metadata/source diff self-reviewed with disclosed mode, required unittest command actually passing against the final committed candidate before tagging; later product changes trigger affected revalidation. Applicable evidence is reused only while current.
criteria.fail_when: Only intended/stale check commands, tests against a different candidate, no substantive final review, fabricated independent review, or tagging before the required candidate gate.
criteria.evidence: Use captured phase execution traces/replies, reports/release.md and retries.md, Git snapshots, adapter outputs/state/events and artifact inspection/execution records. Hidden oracle results are enforced separately by the runner and are not supplied to the semantic scorer. Supplied adapter state alone does not establish chronology.

criteria.fail_when: Workspace-only tests, metadata-only artifact inspection, different build source, stale/mismatched tag or artifact, or artifact not executed.
